The only edit to test/plugin/community-blackhole-noexport-forked.ci since the last judgement is ca5abaf0db, which rewrites the two comment lines above option=env:var=ze_log_bgp_filter_community:value=info to say the forked plugin also receives the dotted key; the option line itself and every input, expect, reject and requirement-tag line are unchanged. The other four tagged units are byte-identical to the last judgement. What the file proves is unchanged: the forked bgp-filter-community answers the ingress chain member and the stored route carries both 65535:666 and 65535:65281. Verdict unchanged: enforced. This is a source rejudgment; the .ci was not re-run by this auditor.
